scripts.build: node tools/build-directory-changes.mjs && node tools/build-og.mjs && astro build && node tools/build-static.mjs
scripts.version:site: node tools/update-version.mjs --stamp && pnpm run build && node tools/update-version.mjs --files
scripts.test: pnpm run build && tsc --noEmit && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm run types && pnpm run test && wrangler deploy --env="" --dry-run
scripts.deploy:preview: pnpm run build && wrangler deploy --env preview
